[[File:ModelCorellianStardriveVanguard.png|thumb|200px|A miniature of the Model Corellian Stardrive Vanguard.]]
The '''Vanguard''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in use in [[3626 BBY]], during a [[Third Galactic War|galactic conflict]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was also available as a remote-controlled miniature.

==Behind the scenes==
The Model Corellian Stardrive Vanguard was a mini-pet that was built as a tribute to the developer team of ''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'' and granted for free to any active player of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' from [[October 20]], [[2020]] to [[November 17]], 2020.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' {{1st}}
